title: A Blue Fairytale
description: This project changes the visuals for some tools, blocks, and other items!
body: This resource pack includes change to all diamond tools/weapons & all netherite tools/weapons, where each respective tool/weapon is 50% smaller. The totem of undying has been changed to a blue cross that has also been shrunk down by 50%. The hotbar is now a blueish-purple, with a pink highlight icon for which slot you have selected. The mace has been changed to be more of a light blue. Diamond armor has been adjusted to be a brighter blue, with the leggings having been adjusted to having a more "frosted" texture. Netherite armor has been adjusted to a deeper "ocean" blue, with some varities/gradients to properly show off the armor. Golden apple + Notch apple are now "golden mangos" (item name has not been changed, just item appearance). Lots of blocks have been changed as well, including but not limited to: obsidian, crying obsidian, deepslate ore(s), diamond ore, deepslate, bedrock, smooth stone [slabs], and more. This texture pack will work great for servers where you need to hide your bedrock, ores, etc (clay has not been hidden in this edition). There is plenty more to discover! This is my first official resource pack, and I am learning how to do all of this yet. Many of the images used in this resource pack are AI, but apart from a few items, I did most of the work myself.
